all_eligible_candidates.view_definition: select `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`dept_id` AS `dept_id`,`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`emp_id` AS `emp_id`,`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`name` AS `name`,`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`designation` AS `designation`,`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`photopath` AS `photopath` from `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list` where (((`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`designation` in ('prof','profhag')) and ((select count(0) from `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list` `sub` where ((`sub`.`dept_id` = `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`dept_id`) and (`sub`.`designation` in ('prof','profhag')))) > 1)) or ((`mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`designation` in ('prof','profhag','ascprof')) and ((select count(0) from `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list` `sub` where ((`sub`.`dept_id` = `mis_40_50`.`all_faculty_list`.`dept_id`) and (`sub`.`designation` in ('prof','profhag')))) <= 1)))
